scope: Opening screen of approved dark kitchen journey; no production changes
purpose: PostTrainLLM helps first-time LLM learners understand data, training and inference through paired kitchen/model decisions and inspectable local artifacts.
purposeSource: PRODUCT.md; DESIGN.md; owner journey brief and opening screenshot

library.posture: Preserve existing native Astro navigation, button and selection behavior, existing owned SVGs and fonts. No new dependency; probes are standalone HTML.

directions.name: Kitchen workbench
directions.screenJob: Understand all six kitchen/model pairs and start gathering data
directions.visualThesis: Asymmetric workspace: concise left introduction, illustrated right workbench, full-width paired process ledger
directions.typography: Bricolage bold display 70px; Geist body; Mono process captions
directions.semanticColorRoles: Existing ink surfaces, teal next action/current stop, muted secondary labels
directions.interactionThesis: Preview the full route, then pick up a basket; right-hand illustration becomes the active workstation
directions.signature: Two aligned process rows map the kitchen actions directly to model-building
directions.risk: Separate introduction remains one click before doing; desktop diagram needs re-composition on phone

directions.name: Illustrated field guide
directions.audience: Readers who want an overview before trying
directions.screenJob: Read one clear premise, compare three lifecycle anchors and start
directions.visualThesis: Editorial title and short invitation over a full-width illustrated triptych and marginal lesson notes
directions.typography: Bricolage 105px title; compact Geist learning outcomes; Mono annotations
directions.semanticColorRoles: Ink editorial canvas, light heading, teal start action and process annotations
directions.interactionThesis: A compact illustrated reading opening leads into the existing one-scene journey
directions.signature: Garden, stove and plate paired with data, weights and answers
directions.risk: Most faithful to existing article direction but introduces less immediate agency

directions.name: Straight into the garden
directions.screenJob: Pick a text source and see it enter the basket before continuing
directions.visualThesis: Experience-first scene: compact title, large garden, three selectable source placards, visible basket receipt
directions.typography: Bricolage 58px headline; 18px source titles; Mono scene state
directions.semanticColorRoles: Ink garden, neutral selectable crop surfaces, teal selection and next step
directions.interactionThesis: The opening is the first real harvest activity; selection advances naturally to cutting
directions.signature: Text sources are clickable crops; basket selection and data/weights state are visible immediately
directions.risk: Needs discoverable keyboard focus and purposeful movement; may overwhelm a reader wanting a plain introduction

toolingLimitations: Installed design-inspiration/SKILL.md and shared design-workflow.mjs are unavailable; no validator pass claimed.

selectionGate.instruction: Ask the owner to select a direction and stop before implementation until they answer.

ownerNote: Owner said give your best deisng after reviewing the three opening directions. Agent selected C to begin with actual data selection and preserve the paired-process journey.

verification.opening: Empty start and visible dinner goal at all five widths, keyboard selection, canonical continuity, reload, empty guard/focus, inspector sync, reduced motion and no-JS pass
verification.wholeJourney: Controlled train/continue/stop/generate/download, changed-batch disclosure, reload and desktop/phone viewport pass; separate actual WASM step and same-weight generation
verification.chat: Same cooked model; no pretrained assistant loaded
verification.publication: Production/docs/knowledge/link gates pass; 607 HTML pages, 31929 internal links and 10331 fragments
verification.formalDesignValidator: Unavailable in installed skill and repository; no shared validator pass claimed

critique.basis: Purpose and kitchen/model correspondence 9; composition and first-screen hierarchy 9; owned illustration and typography 8; real interaction and state continuity 9

audit.basis: Native keyboard selection/focus, known state source, finite reduced motion, first-screen primary actions and recovery pass; no automated WCAG suite run

review.polish: Repaired CSS specificity, narrow-phone inspector overlap, overlapping mobile cards, primary-action styling, inert no-JS controls and muted crop-label contrast

choices: Rice, beans and tomatoes: actual dairy-free recipe
Creamy rice with cheese: actual contrasting recipe
basketRefinement.learningContract: Choose by the goal, inspect actual text; structural cleaning does not judge semantic suitability
basketRefinement.session: Lesson key/schema v2 prevents restoring prior preselected choices; model/trainer state remains untouched
basketRefinement.responsive: Bounded full inspector and horizontally scrollable paired route on phone

realCooking.ownerScope: Bro, let them cook the model.
realCooking.direction: Preserve delegated garden and paired-process workspace; replace authored stove/independent chat with actual cooking.
realCooking.runtime: Existing proven WASM worker, isolated state; no dependencies, OPFS writes or external pretrained weights
realCooking.motion: Steam follows actual training state; reduced motion disables it
realCooking.limits: Real runtime smoke uses one optimizer step, not full-run quality proof. SFT/preferences remain illustrations.

releasePass.scope: Continue owner-delegated garden; release reliability and lifecycle corrections
releasePass.ownerAuthorization: Just make the best version possible, push it, and release it.
releasePass.recovery: Runtime errors and page exit keep the last checkpoint downloadable; counters use serialized optimizer steps
releasePass.codeHealth: No unused kitchen modules or exports; complexity remains at 301; no browser dependency cycles
releasePass.dependencies: No direct package additions. Existing build dependencies patched with same-major overrides; security gate passes without adding exceptions.
